At 3.0 s only the rightmost N starts entering from the left. At 3.125 s the first T is still clipped. All letters are in frame at 3.167 s, but A and N visually merge during compressed re-entry around 3.167-3.25 s.
At 3.292 s all five separate letters read TITAN clearly. Return continues with spacing/width overshoot, settling near center around 3.75-3.83 s, later than the requested approximately 3 s.

On clear samples the spelling and left-to-right order remain TITAN. There is no observed extra word or duplicate letter. Their major recognizable letter forms remain, but the word is not one rigid unchanging graphic.
